description: Schema for airline programs that publish a distance-banded partner award chart broken into regions (e.g. Atmos, Cathay AsiaMiles, Aer Lingus, Iberia, Avianca LifeMiles). Each region has a list of distance bands; each band has cabin-class point costs.

partner_charts.description: One entry per region the chart covers (e.g. Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific).

scope_description.description: Optional clarifier like 'US to Asia Pacific, within Asia Pacific'.

distance_band.description: Raw label as written on the chart (e.g. '701-1,400', '6,001 and above').

own_metal_chart.description: Optional second chart for awards wholly on the program's own carriers (e.g. Alaska + Hawaiian own-metal). Same shape as a partner chart band.

booking_fees_summary.description: Plain-English summary of taxes, partner fees, stopover rules, and other booking-level constraints from the chart page T&C section.
